detail: 18 of 112 candidates audited against three CEBS source protocols: 14 validated using group endpoints, two matrix conflicts, two dose conflicts; 94 unreviewed.

Full registry assessed: 227 resolved unique full-key structures, 26 unresolved identifiers. Exact EPA DTXSID/CAS and source-key validation; cached ChEBI evidence compared. Nonstandard source InChI options are not guessed.
21 primary series have comparable AUC definitions. Unspecified terminal windows and unknown tail fractions remain limitations. Predicted Cmax is excluded from observed-Cmax endpoints.
PMC9316000 Table 2 duplicates 1.25 mg/kg headers and IV-like values; prose describes a 2.5 mg/kg group. No silent correction; all dog endpoints outside adapter scope.
12 primary compounds across 10 source studies remain insufficient for meaningful compound-disjoint molecular ML. Related strata/publications require grouping.

Legacy anonymous statistics and one-record metadata listing succeeded; inspected human study PKDB00954 is closed-licence. New beta endpoints failed TLS. No preclinical exposure data imported or access restrictions bypassed.

CEBS adds 14 validated series and two new PMC publications add three series. Simmitecan XML failed after retries; rotundic acid XML collected but CC BY-NC-ND terms require separate review. FDA/EMA wider extraction remains future work.

3 selected source overlap groups identified by document/DOI and identity. CEBS endpoints validate existing CvTdb studies and are not independent replicates. Remaining incomplete identifiers/protocol links prevent global deduplication proof.

Isoeugenol rat middle dose is 35 mg/kg in one field and 70 in group labels/CvTdb. Benzophenone plasma/blood conflicts remain withheld. Historical vehicle/unit ambiguities remain. Composite endpoints preserve source methods and uncertainty.

EPA DSSTox CC0; CRAN package GPL-3; source PMC CC BY or CC BY-NC. Lorlatinib derivatives remain noncommercial, raw/generated data are not committed. Rotundic acid not imported pending CC BY-NC-ND review.
Direct PubChem REST and ChEBI FTP paths remain disallowed by robots. Public EPA DSSTox bulk CSV, ChEBI and UniChem APIs are used. CIDs are optional and not queried for every resolved identifier.
